stem: A drying lot has acceptable room conditions but large differences in product water activity among containers. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Room conditions alone do not prove product uniformity; investigate product distribution, airflow, loading and sampling
All containers are equivalent because the room average is acceptable
Water activity cannot vary within one room
Only harvest date can explain the difference
rationale: Product state can vary within a drying environment because load distribution, airflow and initial material properties differ. Product measurements are needed alongside room conditions.
